annotations.title: Start a chat with a DJ or a client

description: Start a chat with a DJ or a client. Needs `inbox:write`. Two calls. The first changes nothing: it checks the arguments as the change would (a field this tool does not take is refused, by name) and answers a summary and a confirm_token. Show the summary to the person; only after they agree, call again with the same arguments plus confirm_token.

confirm_token.description: Leave out on the first call. On the second call, the confirm_token the first call answered.

proposal_id.description: A booking (`prop_` id) between the two of us: its chat is answered (the pair's, when the DJ has not accepted it yet).

with.description: The person (`usr_` id). Exactly one of with and with_dj.

with_dj.description: A DJ's `dj_` id or handle. Exactly one of with and with_dj.

name: start_conversation
title: Start a chat with a DJ or a client
